title: MemoryGrantsRevokeRequest
description: Revoke a grant. Allowed during freeze (incident response, §8.2). Terminal; applies to subsequent admissions (MEM-R018). Grant: admin. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
